output.title: Renovated furnished studio apartment in historic Clausen district
output.description:
This furnished studio apartment of 38 m² is located in a historic stone building within Clausen, a UNESCO World Heritage area known for its evocative Alzette valley setting and vibrant nightlife. The studio has been renovated to combine traditional architectural elements with modern comforts, featuring exposed wooden beams and oak-style flooring that enhance its characterful atmosphere.

The living area includes a double bed and a kitchenette equipped with a two-burner cooktop, compact refrigerator, stainless steel sink, and storage cabinets, arranged efficiently in a corner to maximize space. The bathroom has been recently updated with contemporary fittings, including a shower stall and a compact vanity set against white tiled walls.

The building’s setting in the historic Clausen valley offers a serene environment while being situated within a district renowned for its cultural heritage and evening venues. This studio is available to rent fully furnished, suitable for those seeking a residence with a blend of history and modern functionality in Luxembourg’s city landscape.
